strips.title: Revision River Ferry Ending Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led, offline paper strip for shaping a revised ending from one earlier clue: ____________________.
strips.adultSetup: Print one prompt strip, place it beside blank paper, and ask the writer to choose a pretend draft clue to carry across the ferry: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Pick one clue from an imagined first draft, then rewrite the final line so the clue returns in a clearer way: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The draft clue waiting beside Revision River is ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Back prompt: My clearer final sentence brings that clue back by saying ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The ferry guide finds a folded draft strip floating near ____________________.
strips.firstLinePath: First-line path: At first, the clue looked like ____________________; by the ferry, it means ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Cut one extra phrase or add one sharper ending image here: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Copy only the revised final words onto the strip: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this strip later to finish a short paper story about ____________________.

strips.title: Clue Label Tower Detail Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led, offline paper strip for turning one invented museum label into a concrete story detail: ____________________.
strips.adultSetup: Print one strip and set out pencils; the adult names the pretend tower room while the writer fills the first label blank: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Invent one exhibit label, then add three details that let a reader picture it without using any real place name: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The tower label says this exhibit is called ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Back prompt: The label needs a shape ____________________, a color ____________________, and a quiet sound ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A museum helper notices the label points toward ____________________.
strips.firstLinePath: First-line path: The label looked ordinary until ____________________ made the room feel ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one plain detail with a sharper color, texture, or shape: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the label box first, then write one exact detail: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this label strip to start a quiet tower scene about ____________________.

strips.title: Compass Craft Academy Route Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led, offline paper strip for arranging a short story route with a start, turn, and landing place: ____________________.
strips.adultSetup: Print one strip, place it beside a pencil, and ask the writer to mark three pretend compass points before drafting: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Name a start mark, a middle turn, and a final landing place, then turn the route into a clear story path: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The compass route begins at ____________________ and turns when ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Back prompt: The final place on my route is ____________________ because ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A compass crafter changes the academy route when ____________________ appears between two marks.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one precise direction word or distance clue to the middle turn: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number three route marks, then write only the middle one: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this route strip later to draft a paragraph about ____________________.

strips.title: Almost Invention Workshop Test Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led, offline paper strip for improving a pretend invention idea with one clearer object detail: ____________________.
strips.adultSetup: Print one strip and give the writer scratch paper for a plain invention sentence before the clearer detail blank: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Invent something that almost works, then add the missing detail that makes the story problem easier to picture: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Front prompt: My almost invention is called ____________________, and it almost works when ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Back prompt: The missing part, label, or test detail is ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The workshop helper realizes the invention needs ____________________ before the next paper test.
strips.firstLinePath: First-line path: The first test looked like ____________________, but the better test shows ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one vague word with a precise noun, action, or material: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the invention shape, then label only the missing part: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this strip later to write an almost-invention scene about ____________________.

strips.title: Margin Note Market Choice Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led, offline paper strip for building a character choice from one helpful pretend margin note: ____________________.
strips.adultSetup: Print one prompt strip, set out pencils, and tell the writer every note, stall, and character name can be invented on paper: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Write the margin note a character receives, then show how it changes the next choice in the scene: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Front prompt: My character receives a margin note that says ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Back prompt: Because of the note, the character chooses to ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: At Margin Note Market, one folded note asks this question: ____________________.
strips.firstLinePath: First-line path: The character wanted ____________________, but the note pointed toward ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one visible action that proves the character made a new choice: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write only the changed choice on the back of the strip: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this strip later to start a character scene about ____________________.

strips.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Clarity Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led, offline paper strip for choosing one clearer sentence from an imagined boardwalk draft: ____________________.
strips.adultSetup: Print one strip and place it beside blank paper; the adult asks for one pretend boardwalk sentence to sharpen: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Write a sentence from the boardwalk draft, then use the strip to make the meaning clearer for a reader: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The boardwalk draft begins with this cloudy sentence: ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Back prompt: My clearer revision sentence says ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A revision mark appears beside ____________________ and changes what the young author understands.
strips.firstLinePath: First-line path: The first sentence said ____________________; the clearer sentence shows ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Swap one fuzzy word for a precise noun, verb, or detail: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Underline one word silently, then write the clearer replacement here: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this strip later to polish a short boardwalk scene about ____________________.
